rationale: Frozen objective is ttft_ms on a single-GPU Qwen3-4B BF16 SDPA interactive row (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, new_tokens=32): the wall interval between the pre-forward torch.cuda.synchronize() and the explicit first-token-ready synchronize after prefill+argmax (qwen_inference.py:16-24), with exact greedy tokens and 0.02-tolerance logits preserved. The torch collector already ran and closed attribution and graph-tracing questions (coverage.json: 66441/66441 CUDA kernels associated, 0 unassociated, 0 root-only, 0 ambiguous forward sequences, 0 autograd ranges), so torch is not re-requested and its kernel totals remain the attribution source. The two open questions for TTFT are (1) whether the prefill interval is device-bound or host-dispatch/launch-gap bound and (2) which host code dominates submission cost in eager transformers. nsys is available (request.json tools.nsys, verified present) and runs separately at low perturbation: its system timeline resolves the overlap/serialization question (GPU busy fraction and inter-kernel idle gaps inside the first-token window, cudaLaunchKernel/API totals, stream concurrency) and directly observes whether any H2D/D2H memcpy or memset appears in the timed window rather than inferring traffic from payload sizes; it is selected for this overlap question, not to re-attribute kernels already fully associated, and timeline evidence alone will not be used to claim protocol or bucket identity. python_runtime adds a warmed cProfile view of host dispatch and binding cost to locate Python hotspots (transformers modeling code vs torch API vs tokenizer-adjacent setup) guiding which host-side work a TTFT candidate can remove; accepted with the stated caveat that it perturbs execution and its inclusive/self times are not clean performance scores or GPU compute durations. All communication- and candidate-side dimensions are inapplicable or premature for this single-device, pre-candidate state and are listed in unavailable_fields with observed reasons; no workload, quality threshold, provider configuration or objective was changed.
